notes.title: Minigolf - v0.76
notes.content:
[b][h2]Minigolf OUT NOW ![/h2][/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/9b8FHSI.gif[/img]

[b]The biggest minigame to date! 9 holes of minigolf in 3 separate biomes, hidden secrets. Sycamore Minigolf is now available in the Extras menu. [/b]

[b][h3]New Achievements[/h3][/b]
[b]- Hole in One[/b]: Get a hole in one on any level.
[b]- Par[/b]: Complete all holes in at least par.
[b]- Golf³[/b]: Complete any hole as a cube.
[b]- Found a Friend 👽[/b]: Find a hidden alien.
[b]- Fresh[/b]: Wear any bought hat.

[b][h3]Changelog- v0.76[/h3]

- Added Golf Minigame
- Added new Achievements
- Added Minigolf level to main level select
- Updated tutorial/information UI
- Rearranged the minigames list
- Fixed an issue where a player can be frozen in Soccer minigame
- Removed unused pause buttons from Minigame levels
- Fixed some missing leaderboard flags
[/b]

notes.title: Replay Update and Miscellaneous changes
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/RfbEezY.gif[/img]

[b][h3]Changelog: [/h3][/b]
[b]- Added replay spectator mode(Key - C)
- Added user saved visible clothes/hats for local/server replays
- Added more hats
- Added rebind for Spectator/replay watch
- Added opacity setting for replay model
- Multiplayer hats are now synced
- Greatly optimised hat loading/saving
- Limited max FPS to 120
- Altered the way replays save/load
- Smoothed replay playback
- Replays now playback based on the saved users FPS(outdated replays will not playback correctly)
- Fixed an issue where server replays would not load from file
- Reduced maximum client connections to host to 5 per-lobby
- Increased cross-app compatibility between F2P and Paid versions
- Added redundancies for paid users playing the free version
[/b]

[i]Note on replays - Timing may be off and replays may play slow/fast until all replays are re-submitted with new replays.[/i]

notes.title: Sycamore - A New Speedrunning Game Released!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/rNlhlkq.gif[/img]

[b]Find the hidden levels, collect all the coins, or play with friends in Sycamore, a 3D platformer under development based around quick, fast-paced movement where you will race to the end of a level and compete in leaderboard times with players from around the world.[/b]

[h1][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1297030/Sycamore/]AVAILABLE ON STEAM NOW![/url][/b][/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/FxJvil8.gif[/img]

[h2]Features[/h2]

[b]- Responsive platforming controls
- Multiple level biomes
- Multiplayer
- Hidden levels
- CS-Style Surfing
- 3rd and 1st person mode
- Coin collector mode
- Player customisation
- Difficulty scaling
- Record leaderboards
- Full controller support & accessibility options 
[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/JJ6GHOd.gif[/img]
